# The Golden Rule (Matthew 7:12)

## Emotional Focus
Treating others the way we want to be treated.

## Key KJV
“Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them.” (Matthew 7:12)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said the best rule is this: do to others what you want them to do to you. When we are kind, others feel loved.

## Coloring Prompt
Two children sharing toys and smiling at each other while Jesus watches kindly.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus’ golden rule helps us be kind every day.”
